Canvas Commands and History
|-- Shared editing boundary
|   |-- MappingDocumentController coordinates semantic edits and publishes snapshots
|   |   |-- Live canvas: editor driver settles gestures and handles native undo/redo
|   |   `-- Headless proposals: retain domain history through the same controller
|   `-- CanvasHistoryService owns history access and persistence
|       |-- openContext -> frozen runtime handle -> CanvasHistory in a WeakMap
|       |-- Object identity isolates viewers even with the same persisted contextId
|       `-- Runtime handles and service objects are not saved in a canvas
|-- Canonical state: CanvasHistoryRecord                         [canvasHistory.ts]
|   |-- Navigation: baselineId + headId + past[] + future[]
|   |-- diagramRevisions: immutable revisions indexed by revision ID
|   |-- snapshots: StoredCanvasSnapshot indexed by checkpoint ID
|   |   |-- diagramBindings: diagram ID -> revision ID -> diagramRevisions above
|   |   |-- document: canvas composition; scene contains root, not embedded diagrams
|   |   |   |-- GridBox placements + edges + sections + jumps
|   |   |   `-- Presentations, agent contexts, alternatives, selections and reviews
|   |   |-- view: personal MappingCanvasState, separate from composition
|   |   |   |-- Viewport, selection, per-instance diagram views and floating display
|   |   |   `-- Controls: active box/thread, selection focus and control surfaces
|   |   `-- parentId + nodeOrigins + optional transfer transactionId
|   |-- canvasViews: named recordings, saved endpoints and working copies
|   |   `-- Outside checkpoint state restored by undo or applying a saved view
|   `-- document(checkpointId) -> resolved read model for rendering/transport
|       |-- Bind revision diagrams into scene.contents; freeze diagram values
|       |-- Decode logical edge node refs into revision-specific anchors
|       `-- Preserve legacy stale endpoints; jump spans retain source revision
|-- Version-checked command path                         [mappingDocumentController.ts]
|   |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations); transact is the MCP batch adapter
|   |   `-- Settle pending gesture -> check version -> clone current document/view
|   |       |-- Version mismatch -> VERSION_CONFLICT: read the canvas again
|   |       `-- Stage operations in order; later edits see earlier staged revisions
|   |           |-- Diagram content: create, insert, replace, patch, apply revision
|   |           |-- Source context: mappings, evidence, jumps and compiled context
|   |           |-- Composition: move, group, duplicate instance, collapse, remove
|   |           |-- Connections: create, update, remove; validate changed anchors
|   |           `-- Presentation: highlights, alternatives, reviews and selections
|   |-- Reconcile staged consequences before publishing
|   |   |-- Track node correspondence across edits
|   |   |-- Rebase connections/jumps; patch edits also remap section lines
|   |   |-- Normalize per-instance views, selection membership and focus
|   |   `-- Validate scene/connections; clean up orphaned contexts and alternatives
|   |-- updateSnapshot(record=true) -> historyService.append -> CanvasHistory.append
|   |   |-- Validate document, revision dependencies and canonical anchors
|   |   |-- Bind issued revisions; retain alternative/review/selection dependencies
|   |   |-- Store checkpoint with composition, bindings, view and node origins
|   |   `-- Push old head to past -> set new head -> clear future -> record view step
|   `-- Publish controller snapshot -> increment version -> notify subscribers
|       |-- API callers also receive the projected node registry
|       |-- One native gesture includes selection/layout consequences in one checkpoint
|       `-- Transient updateCanvas/layout changes can skip history and version advance
|-- Spatial composition                                      [lineGrid.ts, mappingGrid.ts]
|   |-- LineGridScene = contents table + GridBox tree
|   |   |-- Diagram box references contentId; multiple instances may share content
|   |   `-- Container owns children with parent-relative cell positions
|   |-- resolveScene -> absolute bounds from content, children and minimum size
|   |   `-- Collapsed box uses summary content and hides children
|   |-- updateGridBox -> immutable tree edit -> layoutScene
|   |   |-- Anchor changed subtree at each ancestor
|   |   `-- Settle siblings in stable spatial order, pushing collisions right
|   |-- composeScene validates bounds/collisions and paints printable ASCII
|   `-- insertGridDiagram adds diagram + summary, expands parent and lays out scene
|-- Saved CanvasViews                                           [canvasView.ts]
|   |-- create/save -> pin current state as a named saved endpoint
|   |-- open -> stash outgoing working copy -> resume target working copy or saved end
|   |   |-- Restore as a fresh checkpoint; preserve current camera
|   |   `-- dirty compares composition, bindings and view state excluding viewport/selection
|   |-- fork -> create and open one child from the parent's saved checkpoint
|   |-- alternatives -> create independent children from one pinned saved checkpoint
|   |   |-- Does not switch the active canvas or generate content by itself
|   |   |-- keep -> save chosen child; archive group siblings and their descendants
|   |   `-- discard -> archive target and descendants; leave active branch as needed
|   |-- Generation lifecycle
|   |   |-- startGeneration -> pin saved parent state; create 1-8 candidate records
|   |   |-- Return isolated history for candidate work
|   |   `-- updateGeneration -> validate identity/status and proposed history
|   |       `-- Finished proposal advances candidate endpoint without moving live head
|   |-- start -> record checkpoint IDs -> stop saves recording; cancel drops metadata
|   |-- Comparison reads only pinned start/final endpoints and their revisions
|   |   `-- promote-diffs adds diagram alternatives while retaining original checkpoints
|   `-- apply restores saved endpoint as a fresh checkpoint without transfer linkage
|-- Navigation and workspace transfers                     [canvasHistory.ts, canvasTransfer.ts]
|   |-- Local undo/redo -> validate target -> exchange head with past/future
|   |   `-- Restore document + personal view; saved CanvasViews remain outside navigation
|   |-- reset -> append baseline state as a new undoable checkpoint
|   |-- fork history -> new context/baseline; empty past/future; stop active recording
|   `-- prepareCanvasTransfer -> isolated source/destination histories
|       |-- Require distinct canvases and a nonempty unique selection of diagram boxes
|       |-- Preserve relative placement; remap identities, node refs and links as needed
|       |-- Copy
|       |   |-- Fresh box/content identities; source history stays unchanged
|       |   `-- Copy edges only when both endpoints are selected
|       |-- Move
|       |   |-- Remove selected placements; preserve IDs unless destination conflicts
|       |   |-- Convert source edges to jumps routed to source or destination canvas
|       |   `-- Retarget links to moved diagrams; append source checkpoint
|       |-- Append destination checkpoint; return prepared states + transfer transaction
|       |   `-- Workspace owns publication; transaction records before/after checkpoints
|       `-- Undo/redo transfer requires both canvases at their expected boundaries
|           |-- Newer edits -> reject until those edits are undone
|           |-- Move navigates both histories; copy navigates destination history
|           `-- Local history service rejects linked transfers: use workspace undo/redo
`-- Persistence and validation                                  [canvasHistory.ts]
    |-- persistenceChanges(since) -> navigation/header + changed snapshots/revisions
    |   `-- Sequence cursor and CanvasCheckpointEncoder support incremental storage
    |-- export(currentOnly=true) -> real head + referenced revisions + parent boundaries
    |   `-- Saved views or active recording force full export to retain checkpoint graphs
    |-- adopt(proposed) -> validate revisions -> publish proposed head as one checkpoint
    |   `-- Preserve exact revision IDs and reject conflicting immutable revision content
    `-- Validation checks checkpoint references, revision identity/parents and node refs
        |-- Checkpoints must not embed diagram contents
        |-- Bindings, contexts, alternatives, reviews, selections and anchors must resolve
        `-- Full validation or current-only validation with later checkpoint validation
